answer: Registration binds every identity to a 500-unit escrowed bond, one hardware credential recorded per device, and a proof-of-work record, so a single forge costs a full collateral deposit. Each fake costs 500 units locked for 12 epochs, with a 90 percent slash on detected duplicates. Splitting identities doubles the marginal cost per fake and any shared penalty drains the pool, which an independent juror panel detects before a pulse or inlet node accepts the claim.
